Fence direct completions after cancellation

  description: |-
    Centralize the durable requested-cancellation authority check and apply it before new shared finalizer, Merge, pull request publication, RejectClose, and Agent Dispatch success mutations. Preserve committed completion replay behavior and add PostgreSQL regression coverage that verifies cancel-first finalization leaves artifacts, outboxes, and terminal state untouched.
